newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Alusuisse acquires two British companies.
newsitem.headline: Alusuisse acquires two British companies.

text.p: The Alusuisse-Lonza Group said it had acquired ACI Rockware Ltd from the Rockware Group Ltd and BTR Industries Ltd, a subsidiary of BTR Plc for an undisclosed amount.
Alusuisse said in a statement that ACI's sales in 1996 amounted to 17 million sterling.
ACi is focused on the pharma and cosmetics packaging markets, specialising in plastics injection blow moulding, injection moulding and extrusion blow moulding.
The purchase of ACI is another step in Alusuisse's strategy of expanding the leadership position of its packing division, Lawson Mardon Wheaton (LMW)
ACI is already a licensee of Wheaton technology. Alusuisse acquired U.S. company Wheaton Inc. in 1996.
